# BESSEY Tools – Competence in clamping and cutting technology

Since 1889 BESSEY has been setting standards in hand clamping and cutting technology. Our core
competencies of research and development allow us to continuously create innovative new products
and, to improve upon our current products. BESSEY´s tools are produced from the top quality
materials, using state of-the-art techniques. This allows the highest degree of comfort, safety and
user-friendliness so that you can also benefit from our unique innovation advantage and, in
accordance with our company motto: “BESSEY. Simply better.“

## Our main product areas

## The new one-handed clamp EHK360 with a new rotating 360 handle

The new and innovative BESSEY® 360° rotating trigger clamp is unlike anything else! The ability to
optimize the handle position for clamping (or spreading) improves both clamping ergonomics and tool
versatility by allowing one to position the handle optimally for each job.

## BESSEY on Social Media

Follow us for the latest news about our products and company.

### **The BESSEY Newsletter**

Look forward to regular updates on our tools and their correct application, as well as special
offers and the latest news from BESSEY.

As you were browsing something about your browser made us think you were a bot. There are a few
reasons this might happen:
* You've disabled JavaScript in your web browser.
* You're a power user moving through this website with super-human speed.
* You've disabled cookies in your web browser.
* A third-party browser plugin, such as Ghostery or NoScript, is preventing JavaScript from running.
  Additional information is available in this [support article][1].

To regain access, please make sure that cookies and JavaScript are enabled before reloading the
page.

### Please stand by

We're getting everything ready for you. The page is loading, and you'll be on your way in just a few
moments.

Thanks for your patience!

[1]: http://ds.tl/help-third-party-plugins

# Installation innovation with no through-bolting required

PFCB brackets and PFC angles deliver an elevated installation experience with durable galvanized
steel and tested load capacities. Each comes with Strong-Drive® SDS Heavy-Duty Connector screws for
a complete fastening solution that removes the need for through-bolting — so you can build with
confidence.

[View Products][2]
[Simpson Strong-Tie Timber-SET glued-in rod (GIR) adhesive]

### The first code-listed glued-in rod adhesive in North America

Engineered for reliable, concealed performance in mass‑timber construction, Timber‑SET^{™} epoxy
brings ICC‑ES‑evaluated strength to glued‑in‑rod (GIR) connections in glulam. Its tested formulation
supports high‑capacity, steel‑to‑wood connections while helping streamline installation. Paired with
our complete line of GIR components — including threaded rods, centering and retaining caps,
dispensing tools, and reinforcing screws — it delivers a versatile, job‑ready solution for your next
mass‑timber project.

[View More][3]
[Close-up of outdoor wooden pergola beams with black metal brackets and fasteners, showing
structural hardware attached to natural wood.]

### More strength. More style. More outdoor living.

Build custom backyard structures with an array of decorative hardware that is load-rated, easy to
install and readily available. As part of our Outdoor Accents^{®} decorative hardware line,
Essentials are ideal for building elevated decks, fences, patio covers, pergolas and other
projects. They're made of ZMAX^{®} galvanized steel for superior corrosion resistance with a black
powder-coat for added beauty.

[View Products][4]
[Cover of Simpson Strong-Tie catalog titled 'Connectors for Cold-Formed Steel Construction,' showing
various steel connectors in gray, red, and blue with company logo and contact info.]

### New Catalog: Connectors for Cold-Formed Steel Construction

Our latest Cold-Formed Steel catalog includes specifications, load tables and installation
illustrations for our cold-formed steel connectors and clips, helping you easily specify and install
in commercial curtain-wall, mid-rise and residential construction.

[View Catalog][5]
Connect With Us

# 24-HOUR COMMERCIAL DOOR REPAIR

ANY DOOR, ANYTIME, ANYWHERE!

A-24 Hour Door National: Your Trusted Partner for Maintenance Facility Door Solutions

[1-800-884-4440][182]
[industries][183]
[Products/Services][184]

**[Warranty and Guarantee][185]**

[INDUSTRIES][186]

[SERVICES][187]

## Expert Commercial & Industrial Door Services in Cincinnati, Ohio

Our team of experienced technicians provide professional commercial door services for businesses
across [Cincinnati, Ohio][188], and beyond. We specialize in door installation, repairs, commercial
glass replacement, and emergency board-up services to keep your storefront doors secure and
operating without downtime.

Our AAADM-certified technicians handle all door types, including garage doors, storefronts, security
gates, and industrial solutions. Whether you need a new commercial door or an urgent repair, we are
ready to help.

With fully stocked service trucks and 24/7 emergency response, we provide fast, reliable service for
any type of residential and commercial door when you need it most.

[book service][189]

## Why Locals Trust Our Commercial Door Company in Cincinnati
* **High-Quality Workmanship** – Our certified technicians use top-tier materials for every
  installation and repair.
* **OEM Parts for Reliability** – We source original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts to ensure
  long-term performance.
* **24/7 Emergency Repairs** – Our team is available around the clock to help with urgent commercial
  door issues.
* **Preventive Maintenance Plan**s – Routine garage door inspections can help your company avoid
  costly repairs and extend the lifespan of doors.

[Professional commercial door installation in Cincinnati, OH by A 24 Hour Door. The image shows a
heavy-duty metal door with secure hardware and frame, reflecting expert service for local
businesses.][Professional commercial door installation in Cincinnati, OH by A 24 Hour Door. The
image shows a heavy-duty metal door with secure hardware and frame, reflecting expert service for
local businesses.]

## How A-24 Hour Door National Can Help Secure Your Storefront
* **Premium Materials & Expert Craftsmanship** – Every commercial project we complete meets the
  highest industry standards.
* **OEM Parts for Long-Term Performance** – We use factory-grade replacement parts for all door
  types, including garage doors and [storefront doors][190].
* **100% Satisfaction Guarantee** – If you’re not satisfied, we’ll work tirelessly to make it right.
* **Emergency Services** – Our 24/7 emergency repair team ensures your doors remain secure and
  functional at all times.
* **Preventive Maintenance** – We offer custom maintenance programs to keep warehouses, garages, and
  commercial building doors in Cincinnati operating smoothly.

## Custom Doors for Homes, Facilities & Businesses

We provide[ expert garage door services for businesses][191] in Cincinnati and beyond. Whether you
need a commercial door installation, garage door repair, or specialized door types for warehouses,
storefronts, or industrial businesses, our company is committed to delivering high-quality
solutions.

From garage doors to custom entry systems, we ensure your doors meet safety, security, and
efficiency standards. Contact us today to learn how we can enhance the reliability and performance
of your facility’s doors

### **PROFESSIONAL COMMERCIAL & RESIDENTIAL DOOR SERVICE**

At A-24 Hour Door National Inc, we are your go-to for a comprehensive suite of door services,
including repair, glass replacement, and board-up solutions, designed to minimize downtime for your
enterprise. Our expertise spans 24-hour emergency repairs, garage door servicing, automatic sliding
doors, and security gates, accommodating all business sizes. With a team of AAADM certified
technicians, we offer tailored support to ensure your doors function flawlessly, day and night. We
handle all door types and models, promising swift, reliable service to keep your premises secure and
operational.

A-24 Hour Door National Inc. provides professional door service to businesses and homes. We operate
in three major locations: Buffalo, Cincinnati, and Philadelphia, but we also offer service to many
of the surrounding locations.

We are available for 24/7 emergency service and can provide many door-related services. Our service
trucks are stocked with commonly used parts, allowing us to send a tech out to you immediately. When
it comes to your [home][192] or [business][193], put your trust in a company with thirty years of
experience in the door service market. [Give us a call today][194]!

### The UK's Premier Barn Door Hardware Provider

Barn doors became popular because they solve a real problem — allowing large openings to be closed
without the space required for a traditional swinging door. However, many systems sold today are
designed around appearance rather than performance.

At DoorMate, we specialise in barn door hardware that is engineered to work in real homes. Our
systems are designed to support large, heavy doors correctly, fix securely to real wall
constructions, and operate smoothly over time — not just on day one.

That’s why designers, builders, and homeowners use our systems for kitchens, pantries, bathrooms,
and large internal openings where reliability matters as much as appearance.

To see examples of sliding systems and barn doors we've manufatured and fitted [Click Here][125] for
our Gallery.

### Don't Accept Cheap Imitations

The market is now flooded with mass-produced barn door kits designed to look the part, but often
built without consideration for real door weights, real wall constructions, or long-term
reliability.

Many of these systems are manufactured to a price, not a standard — resulting in poor fixing points,
undersized tracks, noisy rollers, and premature wear. In many cases, they end up needing replacement
far sooner than expected.

At DoorMate, our barn door hardware is engineered to do the job properly. We design and manufacture
our systems in the UK with performance, strength, and longevity in mind, backed by clear fitting
guidance and real technical support should you ever need it.

If you’re investing in a sliding door system, it should work smoothly, fix securely, and continue to
perform for years — not just on the day it’s installed.

If you’d like to discuss a project, need technical advice, or want to speak to someone who
understands sliding door systems properly, you can contact us directly [Clicking Here][126]

### Every Design Made to Order in Our Workshop in Cardiff

We pride ourselves on providing every order custom made here in the UK.

Each item is made with premium parts with a guaranteed lifespan.

What’s more, you can even visit our workshop to go through your requirements in person.

### The UK's Premier Barn Door Hardware Provider

Barn doors became popular because they solve a real problem — allowing large openings to be closed
without the space required for a traditional swinging door. However, many systems sold today are
designed around appearance rather than performance.

At DoorMate, we specialise in barn door hardware that is engineered to work in real homes. Our
systems are designed to support large, heavy doors correctly, fix securely to real wall
constructions, and operate smoothly over time — not just on day one.

That’s why designers, builders, and homeowners use our systems for kitchens, pantries, bathrooms,
and large internal openings where reliability matters as much as appearance.

To see examples of sliding systems and barn doors we've manufatured and fitted [Click Here][125] for
our Gallery.

### Don't Accept Cheap Imitations

The market is now flooded with mass-produced barn door kits designed to look the part, but often
built without consideration for real door weights, real wall constructions, or long-term
reliability.

Many of these systems are manufactured to a price, not a standard — resulting in poor fixing points,
undersized tracks, noisy rollers, and premature wear. In many cases, they end up needing replacement
far sooner than expected.

At DoorMate, our barn door hardware is engineered to do the job properly. We design and manufacture
our systems in the UK with performance, strength, and longevity in mind, backed by clear fitting
guidance and real technical support should you ever need it.

If you’re investing in a sliding door system, it should work smoothly, fix securely, and continue to
perform for years — not just on the day it’s installed.

If you’d like to discuss a project, need technical advice, or want to speak to someone who
understands sliding door systems properly, you can contact us directly [Clicking Here][126]

### Every Design Made to Order in Our Workshop in Cardiff

We pride ourselves on providing every order custom made here in the UK.

Each item is made with premium parts with a guaranteed lifespan.

What’s more, you can even visit our workshop to go through your requirements in person.

➔ What we do

Integrated commercial openings, security, and technology— delivered as one.

CBX Solutions brings doors, frames, hardware, security, and network technology together under one
coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

[Complete opening solutions, done right.]
➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.
[Learn More][11]
➔ Systems Integration

Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.

We design and deliver integrated security solutions that connect physical access with intelligent
control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]
[Access, protection, and intelligence aligned.]
[The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.]
➔ Network Solutions and A/V

The infrastructure that keeps buildings connected.

CBX Solutions supports structured cabling, network infrastructure, and A/V systems that power modern
buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

Beyond doors and hardware, many projects require additional components that support day-to-day
functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates. 

[Learn More][14]
[The details that make buildings work.]
[National Presence. Local Service.®]

## National Presence. Local Service.^{®}

With trusted local teams across the country, CBX Solutions combines national scale with regional
expertise. Our people understand local codes, markets, and relationships—while sharing best
practices across the network to support enterprise and multi-site customers.

[Find a Branch][15]

## Accountability at every stage.

Backed by decades of expertise and delivered through trusted local teams across the country, CBX
Solutions provides services that support your building from design and specification through
installation, maintenance, and long-term system performance.

coordinated approach, so complex commercial buildings work better from day one through long-term
operation. Backed by decades of trust and local experts across a national network, we simplify
complexity, reduce risk, and deliver accountability at every stage of the building lifecycle.

➔ Doors, Frames, and Hardware

Complete opening solutions, done right.

CBX Solutions delivers comprehensive doors, frames, and hardware expertise for commercial
environments of every scale. From specification support and code compliance to project management,
fabrication, installation, and service, we ensure openings perform as designed—safely, reliably, and
without surprises. Our teams work closely with architects, contractors, and owners to coordinate
details early and protect outcomes throughout the project lifecycle.

control. From electronic access control and video surveillance to software and system integration,
CBX Solutions helps protect people, property, and operations. Our coordinated approach ensures
security systems are designed to work with openings—not around them—creating safer, smarter
environments.
[Learn More][12]

buildings. Our teams align technology planning with physical environments to ensure reliability,
scalability, and long-term performance. Whether supporting new construction or ongoing operations,
we help keep systems connected, coordinated, and future-ready.

[Learn More][13]
➔ Specialty Solutions

The details that make buildings work.

functionality. CBX Solutions provides specialty products such as operable partitions, toilet
partitions, lockers, and other architectural specialties. These systems support the spaces people
use every day and play a critical role in how a building operates.

## Product Visualizer

Design your products exactly how you want them with our NEW MyEmtek tool, and save the details to
your Favorites. The MyEmtek tool allows you to customize our passage and privacy levers and knobs
with your perfect style and finish combinations for both sides of the door.

[Start Creating with MyEmtek][73]

EMTEK DESIGN

## The Spoke Knob

Be it art, architecture or interior design, Emtek products take inspiration from all walks of
life—including our daily commute. Echoing the wheel of a bicycle, the Spoke Knob is the flagship
piece in the Studio Brass line dedicated to bringing boutique design straight to your door.

[Get a Closer Look][74]

EMTEK DESIGN

## The Galapagos Project

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D
printed metals. Each 3D printed handle will represent their own variation of The Galapagos Project.
Emulating nature, no two pieces will be identical.

[See More of the Concept Design Here][75]

#### Who Is Evermark?

Our cutting-edge offerings in stair parts, doors, frames, jambs, hinges, hardware, and more
challenge the status quo while enhancing a home’s value and beauty.

Founded in 1993, Evermark is a stair parts manufacturer, as well as manufacturer of doors, frames,
jambs, hinges, and hardware. We own factories in Asia and the US, along with multiple warehouses
across the country to serve our retail and wholesale customers. Headquartered in Suwanee, GA, we
employ more than 800 people at our various locations.

Evermark’s mission is to optimize the creativity and passion of our people to drive innovation and
instill superior design into products, ensuring the highest levels of value and quality for
customers. From humble beginnings, we’ve become a major provider of home building and renovations
solutions.

# Barn Door Hardware, Home Theater Decor, and Professional Movie Theater Products

Crafting distinctive home decor and furniture products, including award-winning Goldberg Brothers
sliding barn door hardware kits.
[Our Barndoor Hardware][58] [Request a Quote][59]
[Goldberg Brothers][Goldberg Brothers]

## About Goldberg Brothers, Inc.

Goldberg Brothers, Inc. is has been manufacturing household and industrial hardware since 1897.
Still proud to be made in the USA, today the company focuses on crafting distinctive home decor and
furniture products, including award-winning Goldberg Brothers Barn Track sliding barn door hardware
kits.

[Learn More][60]

## Our Products

Our USA-based factory makes products for homes, offices, movie theaters, and B2B manufacturing
clients.

[
[Barn Door Hardware][Barn Door Hardware]

### Barn Door Hardware

Our barn door hardware sets and tracks will make any doorway a grand opening, whether your style is
contemporary, industrial or farmhouse chic.

Learn More
][61]
[

### LEEV^{®} Secure Delivery Products

Add a smart deadbolt lock to these powder-coated steel doors to securely accept packages even when
you are not home.

Learn More
][62]
[
[Movie Theater Hardware][Movie Theater Hardware]

### Movie Theater Hardware

We manufacture a wide range of specialty hardware to make your movie theater function and look as
sharp as possible.

Learn More
][63]
[
[House Number Signs and Apartment Number Signs][House Number Signs and Apartment Number Signs]

### House Number Signs & Apartment Number Signs

Goldberg Brothers house number signs are an attractive, uniform way to identify addresses.

Learn More
][64]
[

### Home Theater Decor

If you love movies like we do, then let us help you deck out your home theater with nostalgic and
fun film reel decor.

Learn More
][65]
[
[Custom Metal Fabrication][Custom Metal Fabrication]

### Custom Metal Fabrication

Make Goldberg Brothers your company’s manufacturing partner for custom-fabricated metal products and
components.

Learn More
][66]

## Why Choose Us

[Why Choose Us][Why Choose Us]

### **Experience -** Goldberg Brothers has been making industrial and residential hardware in the
### USA since 1897. We have supplied quality products to government agencies, industrial clients,
### and millions of consumers around the world.

[Why Choose Us][Why Choose Us]

### **Dedication -** As a small, family-owned company, every product that leaves our factory serves
### as evidence of our dedication to superior design, quality manufacturing, and long service life.

[Why Choose Us][Why Choose Us]

### **Integrity -** We stand behind our products and services. We believe in treating our customers
### with fairness and respect. We are proud to support the communities we serve.

[About Us][67]
[Why Choose Us][Why Choose Us]

Meet inspection standards and keep projects moving.

## #### Incredibly Fast Delivery
## 
## [fast delivery icon@2x.png]

Penrod offers fast delivery of its extensive supply of door frames, hinges and hardware, door

##

Our clients confidently depend on us for reliable door hinges and hardware, weather strips, and door

professionalism and expertise.

in cultivating lasting customer relationships founded on trust, commitment, and confidence in our
manufacturer's warranties.

[tab down arrow]

#### **PENROD'S ROOTS**

From its inception in 1888 as a manufacturer of forest products, Penrod has grown to be one of the
world’s largest suppliers of forest products, metal & PVC products, and hardware-related door needs
for the residential and commercial construction markets. With ofﬁces in every major region around
the globe, distribution centers on most continents, and an efﬁcient trade network, we are an
international leader in the industries we service. Penrod is proud to embrace the concept of
sustainable forestry as an essential element to our success as a company and as a solidly
compliant, responsible global citizen.

in cultivating lasting customer relationships founded on trust, commitment, and confidence in our
manufacturer's warranties.

From its inception in 1888 as a manufacturer of forest products, Penrod has grown to be one of the
world’s largest suppliers of forest products, metal & PVC products, and hardware-related door needs

the globe, distribution centers on most continents, and an efﬁcient trade network, we are an
international leader in the industries we service. Penrod is proud to embrace the concept of
sustainable forestry as an essential element to our success as a company and as a solidly

complete OEM & ODM services for sliding door rollers, bathroom fittings, door hardware, and
connectors. All production—from molding to assembly—is carried out in-house, ensuring strict quality
control and faster lead times. We serve global clients across 80+ countries with over 2,000 sets of
ready molds, flexible customization capabilities, and stable inventory for fast delivery.

## We have been manufacturing door, window and architectural hardware for over 25 years.

With over 25 years of manufacturing experience, HIPAD is a direct hardware manufacturer providing
complete OEM & ODM services for sliding door rollers, bathroom fittings, door hardware, and
connectors. All production—from molding to assembly—is carried out in-house, ensuring strict quality
control and faster lead times. We serve global clients across 80+ countries with over 2,000 sets of
ready molds, flexible customization capabilities, and stable inventory for fast delivery.

[Browse Complete FAQ Library][155]
Can the hardware be used in an outdoor setting?

While the hardware can be used outside, the bolts that come with the kit are not exterior grade. If
you are using the kit outdoors, please change out all the bolts for exterior grade bolts. If the
doors you are using are very heavy, also think about swapping the provided bolts for Grade 8 bolts
instead. And to be on the safe side, please also coat the hardware in an anti-rust sealant.

Do I need a header board if I have trims or uneven walls?

Yes. A header board is strongly recommended if studs are not aligned with the installation area, or
if decorative trims interfere with mounting. It ensures structural integrity and long-term
stability.


How much clearance above the door do I need?

A minimum of **6–8 inches** of clearance is required above the opening to accommodate the track and
rollers. This is consistent with most sliding barn door hardware specifications.


If the track is too long, can I cut it down?

Yes. Tracks are made of steel or aluminum and may be cut with proper metal-cutting tools.

Can the hardware be used in an outdoor setting?

While the hardware can be used outside, the bolts that come with the kit are not exterior grade. If
you are using the kit outdoors, please change out all the bolts for exterior grade bolts. If the
doors you are using are very heavy, also think about swapping the provided bolts for Grade 8 bolts
instead. And to be on the safe side, please also coat the hardware in an anti-rust sealant.

Do I need a header board if I have trims or uneven walls?

Yes. A header board is strongly recommended if studs are not aligned with the installation area, or
if decorative trims interfere with mounting. It ensures structural integrity and long-term
stability.


How much clearance above the door do I need?

A minimum of **6–8 inches** of clearance is required above the opening to accommodate the track and
rollers. This is consistent with most sliding barn door hardware specifications.


If the track is too long, can I cut it down?

Yes. Tracks are made of steel or aluminum and may be cut with proper metal-cutting tools.

### About INOX

An innovative company serving residential, commercial, hospitality, and healthcare industries, INOX
is a leader in door hardware design, engineering and manufacturing.

INOX has the ability and experience to integrate elegant luxury designs with engineered strength to
meet stringent compliance regulations and endure harsh environments. INOX has supplied some of the
most beautiful resorts, homes, and retails spaces in the world.

INOX products continue to revolutionize the industry, from the world's first barn door privacy locks
to electrified sliding door mortise locks with touchless unlocking and auto-locking capabilities.

## [Why Ives][99]

The oldest of the Allegion Americas brands, since 1876, Ives has provided an expansive offering of
architectural accessories including hinges, pivots, and door pulls, edge guards, protection plates,
coordinators and much more. Don’t let the small hardware fool you. Our hardware has a big job; to
prevent opening vulnerabilities or failures in security, life-safety, and operation. Ives hardware
exceeds that challenge and stands behind our products with best-in-class sales consultants, experts,
and Allegion services.

Our high-quality **architectural hardware** seamlessly combines form and function, offering the
perfect finishing touch for your spaces. Our selection of **furniture hardware** includes drawer
pulls, shelving brackets, furniture legs, and more, all designed to enhance durability and ease of
use. For innovative wire management, we also provide **grommets** that reinforce openings and
provide smooth and efficient operation. Essential in office, residential, hospitality, and
educational environments, these products elevate furniture and fixtures to meet modern demands.

Our **fine architectural hardware** empowers you to design more efficiently while making sure every
detail contributes to the bigger picture. Each piece offers the dual benefit of streamlined
installation processes and enduring performance. Every element of our collection is
precision-engineered, making even the smallest updates impactful. Explore our collection of **fine
architectural hardware** to bring both beauty and utility to your interior spaces.

#### Welcome to

### Northshore Barn Doors

## Serving New England and Beyond

Northshore Barn Doors is your premier destination for high-quality interior barn doors and hardware.
Our handcrafted barn doors are designed to add a touch of rustic charm and functionality to any
space.


Whether you're renovating your home or working on a commercial project, we are dedicated to helping

create living space for guests and family in the newly finished basement. The Barndoorist was also
asked to create some elements of this space, and they include: The installation of a unique art
door—we went with one we had already made for display in our Amesbury, MA workshop, and the couple
loved it so Scott framed the entryway so it would fit perfectly, being wider than the newly framed
entryway. A master bedroom artisan headboard—we crafted this out of part of an old metal fire door
and added wood and steel elements, and two cedar posts that had come out of the basement supports
during reno. A rustic shelf around one post in the downstairs bathroom using the same aged pine that
upstairs shelves had been made from. The brown aged pine boards for the rustic wall that Scott made
built in bunks around. We “Japan-torched” 1x8 wide strapping stock and waxed the wood with dark
brown Bri-Wax, and he assembled and created the surround. The photos and videos show the space and
how these pieces were installed and we really appreciate the help Scott provided; and of course, the
in-home passion and love for artisan workmanship that Susan and Dave entrusted my small company to
perform in their beach house. We very much enjoy working with good people who like the old Yankee
craftmanship and unique styles we create, and you can’t get these at the local home center!

Field Guide

## The Most Common Sliding Door Problems We Fix

Sliding doors fail in predictable patterns. After 15+ years and 10,000+ repair jobs, six problems
account for roughly 90 percent of service calls. Recognizing the symptom is the first step to
knowing whether you need a quick fix or a full replacement.

[JDM technician after a sliding glass door repair on a Florida balcony]
**90%** of service calls fall into these 6 issues
1. 01
   
   ### Door drags or won't slide smoothly
   
   Almost always worn rollers, a dirty track, or both. A tech can usually restore smooth operation
   in under an hour.
2. 02
   
   ### Door came off the track
   
   Rollers have failed or the track is damaged. Do not force the door back on without inspection,
   because forcing it usually causes more damage.
3. 03
   
   ### Lock won't engage or feels loose
   
   The mortise lock or keeper plate is worn, misaligned, or broken. This is a security risk and
   should be addressed within the week.
4. 04
   
   ### Glass is cracked, fogged, or broken
   
   Tempered glass can be replaced without replacing the full door. Fogged double-pane glass means
   the seal has failed and the insulating gas escaped.
5. 05
   
   ### Water or air leaks around the door
   
   Weatherstripping, threshold seal, or frame gasket has failed. Common after 7 to 10 years, and
   faster in coastal markets.
6. 06
   
   ### Handle is loose, broken, or missing parts
   
   Handle assemblies are a common repair. Most brands stock replacement hardware we carry on our
   service vans.
Why It Matters

## Why Choose a Specialist Over a Handyman

Sliding doors are deceptively complex. A standard patio slider has more than 30 moving parts
including rollers, carriages, tracks, cam locks, mortise locks, keeper plates, handles, sweeps,
gaskets, and weep holes. General handymen and general contractors rarely stock these parts and often
misdiagnose the root cause, applying temporary fixes that fail within months.

A specialist diagnoses the full system in one visit, carries manufacturer-specific parts for the
brands common to each market, and repairs the actual cause rather than the symptom. That is why our
flat-rate repairs hold up where general contractors' temporary fixes fail.

Field Guide

## The Most Common Sliding Door Problems We Fix

Sliding doors fail in predictable patterns. After 15+ years and 10,000+ repair jobs, six problems
account for roughly 90 percent of service calls. Recognizing the symptom is the first step to
knowing whether you need a quick fix or a full replacement.

[JDM technician after a sliding glass door repair on a Florida balcony]
**90%** of service calls fall into these 6 issues
1. 01
   
   ### Door drags or won't slide smoothly
   
   Almost always worn rollers, a dirty track, or both. A tech can usually restore smooth operation
   in under an hour.
2. 02
   
   ### Door came off the track
   
   Rollers have failed or the track is damaged. Do not force the door back on without inspection,
   because forcing it usually causes more damage.
3. 03
   
   ### Lock won't engage or feels loose
   
   The mortise lock or keeper plate is worn, misaligned, or broken. This is a security risk and
   should be addressed within the week.
4. 04
   
   ### Glass is cracked, fogged, or broken
   
   Tempered glass can be replaced without replacing the full door. Fogged double-pane glass means
   the seal has failed and the insulating gas escaped.
5. 05
   
   ### Water or air leaks around the door
   
   Weatherstripping, threshold seal, or frame gasket has failed. Common after 7 to 10 years, and
   faster in coastal markets.
6. 06
   
   ### Handle is loose, broken, or missing parts
   
   Handle assemblies are a common repair. Most brands stock replacement hardware we carry on our
   service vans.
Why It Matters

## Why Choose a Specialist Over a Handyman

Sliding doors are deceptively complex. A standard patio slider has more than 30 moving parts
including rollers, carriages, tracks, cam locks, mortise locks, keeper plates, handles, sweeps,
gaskets, and weep holes. General handymen and general contractors rarely stock these parts and often
misdiagnose the root cause, applying temporary fixes that fail within months.

A specialist diagnoses the full system in one visit, carries manufacturer-specific parts for the
brands common to each market, and repairs the actual cause rather than the symptom. That is why our
flat-rate repairs hold up where general contractors' temporary fixes fail.

Local knowledge matters too. Coastal Florida doors face salt corrosion. Northeast doors face
freeze-thaw cycles. Desert markets deal with UV degradation and track grit. A specialist picks parts
and procedures suited to the local environment.
